hits.snippet: The release marks NetBrain’s first major update under new CEO Bernadette Nixon, who joined the company in January. hits.snippet: I am proud to share I have joined NetBrain Technologies Inc. as CMO. NetBrain has spent 20 years helping enterprises prevent outages and automate the management of the world's most complex networks. Some of the largest enterprises rely on them daily—a position earned through technical depth and relentless focus on customer success. Now comes the next evolution: Agentic NetOps—bringing autonomous, AI-driven operations to enterprise infrastructure. Two decades of building network intelligence into the platform, now ready to act. I'm proud to join a team led by Bernadette Nixon—reunited from our days at CA Technologies. I've watched Bernadette build an impressive track record as CEO since and love her passion and customer focus. Founder LP Gao, who built an amazing business, provides us leadership and vision on the board as the company enters its next chapter. My first week was at the company kickoff, where I met product, engineering, and customer teams with deep expertise in enterprise networking—many over a decade at NetBrain. hits.snippet: Alongside the transaction, NetBrain announced several leadership updates to support its next phase of growth. Bernadette Nixon has been appointed Chief Executive Officer and will join the Board of Directors. Founder Lingping Gao will transition from CEO to Chair of the Board after more than two decades building NetBrain from concept to category leader. Gus Malezis and Jerry Guo also join the Board, adding deep experience in scaling enterprise and infrastructure software companies.
